dedupeText: mid century soul album cover layout 1960s soul circular portrait arched typography tri color split mid century modern arched title text mirroring the curve of the central circular portrait high contrast navy blue field acting as a grounding weight for the central image symmetrical balance anchored by a central vertical axis color coded hierarchy separating artist name title and track details three tier horizontal split arched display type circular portrait inset condensed subtitle

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier horizontal composition featuring a cream top section with arched display type, a deep navy blue middle section containing a circular photographic inset, and a cream bottom footer with a dense tracklist grid.
coreVisualRelationships: Arched title text mirroring the curve of the central circular portrait
High-contrast navy blue field acting as a grounding weight for the central image
Symmetrical balance anchored by a central vertical axis
Color-coded hierarchy separating artist name, title, and track details
coreInvariants: Circular portrait frame with a thick cream border
Horizontal division of the canvas into three distinct color blocks
Arched display typography at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is centered within a circular frame occupying the middle 50% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular portrait frame serves as the primary focal point, supported by the bold black artist name above it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: Arched title leads to the artist name, then drops into the circular portrait, finally resting on the detailed tracklist at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous cream margins at the top and bottom provide breathing room for dense typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white used for the top and bottom backgrounds.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Navy Blue used for the central horizontal band.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt Orange/Red used for the arched title text and subject's clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, vintage saturation levels with high value contrast between the navy band and cream fields.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to cream, navy, black, and one warm accent color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of heavy slab serifs and condensed sans-serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Arched title uses high-waisted, heavy slab serifs with tight kerning
Artist name uses a bold, ultra-condensed sans-serif
Metadata and tracklist use a clean, geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title characters are rotated individually to follow a precise semi-circular arc

composition.relationshipToImage: frames the top of the layout

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a decorative arched slab-serif with a functional, rigid condensed sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule separating the top cream section from the navy band
Ornate blue filigree/scrollwork icon centered under the title
Circular mask with a double-stroke border

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, vintage slab-serif feel of the title.
Captures the condensed, bold authority of the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-tier horizontal layout. Top 35% is cream, middle 50% is deep navy blue, bottom 15% is cream. In the center of the navy band, place a circular photographic portrait of a man in a red shirt, framed by a thick cream border. Add a small blue filigree scroll in the top cream section.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply arched burnt-orange slab-serif text in the top cream section. Place a bold, black, condensed sans-serif name directly below it. Add a dense grid of small black sans-serif text in the bottom cream footer.

verificationChecks: Is the title text arched in a semi-circle?
Is the central portrait contained within a perfect circle?
Are there three distinct horizontal background color zones?
Is the artist name in a condensed black sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Curvature of the top arched text
Thickness of the navy blue central band
Diameter of the circular portrait frame
Accent color for the title text
mustRedesign: Any modern digital logos or barcodes
Specific artist names or track titles
Record label branding in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the navy band is perfectly horizontal.
Check that the arched text is centered over the circle.
Verify the cream color has a warm, aged tone.
Confirm the tracklist text at the bottom is legible but small.
recipe.reuseFormula: Three-tier horizontal split + Arched Display Type + Circular Portrait Inset + Condensed Subtitle.
